exposure: Hysteroscopic treatment of cesarean scar defect using the 16 Fr mini-resectoscope
Hysteroscopic treatment of cesarean scar defect using the 26 Fr resectoscope
hysteroscopic treatment of cesarean scar defect using the 26 Fr resectoscope
cohort: 309 women with symptoms and a cesarean scar defect diagnosis
finding: The study found that isthmoplasty with a 16 Fr mini-resectoscope is as effective as a 26 Fr resectoscope in reducing postmenstrual abnormal uterine bleeding and suprapubic pelvic pain, with a shorter surgical time and fewer complications.
